Definition: Eljehoenai or Eljoenai, the name of seven Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Elioenai or Elihoenai = "unto Jehovah are my eyes"; 1) a Korahite temple doorkeeper, son of Meshelemiah; 2) two men with foreign wife during the exile; one a priest; 3) a son of Neariah; 4) a Simeonite; 5) a Benjamite, son of Becher
